BL-1932 — On a deterministic-coordinator pack, swarm ensure, the mono-router topology and babysitterd never respawn, flag or repair the absent coordinator seat, even with a stale coordinator launch script on disk
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: FIRM: on a pack declaring coordinator_mode deterministic a missing coordinator pane is not a fault: ensure creates nothing, babysitterd raises no pane-coordinator finding and repairs nothing, and the mono-router topology does not count the coordinator as standing. Packs without the declaration keep…
BL-1932 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1932" (or "reject BL-1932 <reason>") to act.
